query: The group has long described their pre-dawn meet at the trailhead on race-prep days as the standard. Does this convention apply to everyone? If not, name one member who pushes against it and what they actually prefer.
gold: No, the convention does not apply to everyone. Sonia is one clear exception: when the meet-time was reopened, she said flatly that "some of us are not running pre-dawn" and that she would catch up at the trailhead breakfast at 8:30am, framing it as a fact about her, "i didn't join a running club to wake up at 5am every saturday." The same exchange surfaces Iris and Marcus pushing back on the same convention, leading the group to formalize a 6:12am wave and a 7:30am wave instead of one universal pre-dawn meet.

query: The group treats the post-outing brewery stop at Hawthorne's as the default plan after long days out. Does this default actually apply to everyone? If not, name one member who quietly opts out and what they prefer instead.
gold: No, the default does not apply to everyone. Owen quietly opts out: when Sonia named the brewery as the default after the maintenance day, Owen replied "Brewery pass." In his voice that two-word reply is decisive, and the same conversation surfaces Bernard and Ana also stepping out. Owen's actual preference, made visible across the corpus, is to go straight from trail work into off-trail scouting or home, not to a social bar setting.
